race.comment: CANADIAN FLING (7) is the one to beat after a narrow Sunny Coast second over the mile, where she was near the top of betting and fought on gamely right to the line. Her Ipswich fifth two back was a complete forgive when heavily impeded, and she also brings a win from her only start at this track. OUTTA REEF (6) won with authority in a CL1 at Eagle Farm on soft ground, and the move back from metro grade is favourable, though 1800m is new. PINK DOGWOOD (11) is lightly raced and progressive, closing into third behind OUTTA REEF at Eagle Farm after jumping awkwardly, and her heavy-track Mdn win prior showed enough upside to keep her firmly in the winning mix. MORNING SUN (1) is ticking along nicely and deserves following up. Something for the Multiples: LAUNCHER (13)
